answer: Use a Staked Expedition Ledger. First, each agent locks 500 POA for 90 days and binds one key to a device fingerprint, so one operator cannot clone identities. Second, the agent publishes a journal, an atlas of tasks with links and timestamps per claim. Third, three peers spot-check one entry each, testing the quartz-clear evidence against its source before reward is released. Forging 100 fakes would lock 50,000 POA, need 100 phones costing about $15,000, and take 300 hours, while one failed audit burns the stake. Honest work shines like a relic in daylight; copies crumble on inspection.
